gold_sql:
WITH origin AS (
  SELECT ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-117.055952 32.996822)',4326) AS pt
),
nearby_tiles AS (
  SELECT d.rast
  FROM public.dem_us d, origin o
  WHERE d.rast && ST_Expand(o.pt, 1.0)
),
masked AS (
	  SELECT ST_MapAlgebra(
	           rast,
	           1,
	           '32BF'::text,
	           'CASE WHEN [rast.val] < 80 THEN [rast.val] ELSE NULL END'::text,
	           NULL::double precision
	         ) AS rast
  FROM nearby_tiles
),
qualifying_pixels AS (
  SELECT (pp).geom AS geom
  FROM masked
  CROSS JOIN LATERAL ST_PixelAsCentroids(rast, 1, TRUE) AS pp
)
SELECT MIN(ST_Distance(p.geom::geography, o.pt::geography)) AS distance_m
FROM qualifying_pixels p, origin o;

WITH poi_geom AS (
  SELECT ST_SetSRID(ST_MakePoint(-117.055952, 32.996822), 4326)::geography AS geom
),
low_elevation_area AS (
  SELECT ST_Union(rast) AS rast
  FROM public.dem_us
  WHERE ST_Intersects(rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326))
),
clipped_low_elevation AS (
  SELECT ST_Clip(low_elevation_area.rast, true, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS rast
  FROM low_elevation_area, poi_geom p
),
nearest_point AS (
  SELECT ST_ClosestPoint(clipped_low_elevation.rast, ST_Transform(p.geom::geometry, 4326)) AS nearest_point
  FROM clipped_low_elevation, poi_geom p
)
SELECT ST_Distance(p.geom, (SELECT nearest_point FROM nearest_point)) AS distance_meters
FROM poi_geom p;
